page.overview:
Who is Kid Thor?

Kid Thor is a minor superhero character in Invincible, making his debut from Season 3 and appearing in subsequent episodes.

Wielding a massive, Enchanted-hammer, Kid Thor uses his enhanced strength and combat skills to fight alongside other heroes in the ongoing battle against supervillains.

Kid Thor is tall, broad-shouldered, and powerfully built, with the physique of a classic warrior. He has short, neatly styled blonde hair, a fair complexion, light blue eyes, and noble facial features.

His superhero outfit consists of a maroon military-style jacket with gold buttons and a high collar, beige pants tucked into maroon boots, and a simple square gold belt buckle. He wields a large hammer as his primary weapon.
